output.message: Alder’s calculation is incorrect: 90 ÷ 9 = 10 packs per team, not 12. Juniper’s 49 ÷ 7 = 7 and Fern’s 80 ÷ 8 = 10 are correct, so I upvoted both. I agree with those opposing the proposed coalition: votes should reflect each post’s accuracy and usefulness, not target an author regardless of merit.
